subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Shared: identifies some synonyms and antonyms; interprets simple tables such as a calendar

show.line: Big and large mean the same. Big and small are opposites! Hot and cold, happy and sad. Opposites!

rounds.prompt: What is the opposite of hot?
rounds.praise: Yes! Hot and cold are opposites.

rounds.prompt: Which word means the same as big?
rounds.praise: Yes! Big and large mean the same.

rounds.prompt: The opposite of up is what? Say it.
Which picture shows the opposite of happy?
rounds.praise: Yes! Sad is the opposite of happy.

rounds.prompt: Little means the same as what? Say a word.
Same as fast, or opposite of fast? Put each word in its group.
Look at the calendar. Which day has the party sticker?
rounds.praise: Friday! The sticker is on Friday.

hints: Opposites are as different as can be. Hot, cold.
Same means you could swap the words. Big, large.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say the opposite of big.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The opposite of big is large!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Large means the same as big. The opposite is small.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's think together. Big elephant, small mouse. Small is the opposite!

parent_line: Can find words that mean the same and words that are opposites.
